title: the-return-trip-is-countable
intention: ARM /design's OWN WATCH. The door's build claim is one sentence in its charter: 'this door is where that arrival becomes data' — the arrival being a node routed back from /sorted on a completeness red, recorded as entering_from: sorted:<berth>, which is the denominator /intent's charter names as missing. The charter's how_it_learns ends 'NOT-YET: nothing reads it'. This ticket compiles the reader: a probe at skills/design/probes/design_return_trip.py that walks answers.entering_from across the design berths (denominator: distinct nodes, not firings), reads /sorted's own ledger for promised back-to-design dispositions, fires when a season of design work shows zero recorded returns, and clears on the first witnessed arrival — then carries the boat from its standing red through WATCHME to PROVED.
why: Law 3 — the return-trip count is the measurement /design exists to make, and until one arrival is witnessed the build claim is unfalsified, not proven. Law 9 gives the distance: the boat is built, proven, sealed, and NOT WATCHED — 'exit REFUSED for want of a probe' journaled since 2026-08-04. The lived symptom is the charter's own: a node routed back for completeness re-enters design and nothing anywhere records that it is a second pass, so 'which of /intent's questions are failing to catch things' has no denominator.
traces_to: Law 3 — nothing is known until measured; one witnessed arrival is the existence measurement
Law 9 — the standing 'exit REFUSED for want of a probe' is the red this closes
Law 1 — the rate question is left to the count's consumer, carried deliberately, never a watch silently staying up
decision 2026-08-07-the-implementation-order — tier 2, the ruled starting place

falsifier.proves_green: skill@v2's registered set: build gate at the PROVEME forward crossing (build_inspector's sieves over skills/design itself); emission gate at the WATCHME forward crossing (cairn/tools/base/watchme_spec.py — spec complete, probe berthed and armed); exit gate at the PROVED entry (proved_answers_the_chart, clean by absence unless a chart claims this ticket); proof gate: skills/design/proofs/test_design_door.py (30 teeth), green twice and sealed netns 2026-08-04.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the probe cannot read entering_from off real berths (measured green at cast: openings=2, nodes=2, returns=0, promised_returns=0 — this voyage's own two openings are the first denominator rows); the watch can clear before it can fire (structurally excluded — fire needs returns == 0, clear needs returns >= 1); the emission gate refuses the crossing; or the boat still stands short of PROVED when this ticket claims done.
falsifier.horizon: Re-read at: the first recorded return trip (the clear — and the moment the rate question opens for its own consumer); the first promised-without-arrival mismatch (the swallowed-return fork, the door's own lived symptom measured); the beat becoming a real number (re-tune the probe's 1000-pulse _HORIZON); and when the door's cadence makes the hand-set floor of 12 nodes tunable (learns-its-gates IOU, named at the cast).
